evidence.title: Encrypted Dispatch: Payout Terms
evidence.description: Decrypted payload snippet: 'Transfer confirmed upon Chimera sequence verification. Escrow release $150k in XMR once hash validates.'
evidence.viva_explanation: Establishes clear financial motive for Ryan Mehta.

evidence.title: Costa Cafe CCTV & Cashier Receipt
evidence.description: High-definition timecoded footage showing Arjun Kulkarni and Nisha Kapoor seated at table 4 discussing journal papers continuously from 19:15 to 20:30.
evidence.viva_explanation: Solidifies Arjun's ironclad alibi, disproving the primary red herring.

evidence.title: CCTV Camera 04: Rear Fire Stairs
evidence.description: Footage shows a hooded figure wearing a distinctive navy Gore-Tex jacket with reflective orange sleeve trim (identical to Ryan's jacket) leaving the 3rd-floor lab staircase in haste.
evidence.viva_explanation: Direct physical opportunity evidence placing Ryan at the crime scene during his alleged library alibi window.

evidence.title: Cafeteria Register Scan #890
evidence.description: Digital payment log showing Dr. Maya purchasing double espresso at 19:32, corroborating her statement that she was away from her 3rd-floor desk.
evidence.viva_explanation: Proves the victim left her workstation unattended between 19:30 and 20:45.

evidence.title: Lab Terminal 04 Exfiltration Log
evidence.description: Kernel log: 'USB mass storage device [SanDisk Ultra 128GB, S/N: SD-88319] mounted. Command executed: tar -czf /media/usb/chimera_dump.tar.gz /vault/data/chimera/*'.
evidence.viva_explanation: The exact forensic moment and method of file theft.

evidence.title: Door #3 Keycard Access Record
evidence.description: Badge reader scanned Keycard KC-9021 (assigned to Dr. Maya) to unlock lab entrance while Maya was registered downstairs in cafeteria.
evidence.viva_explanation: Proves unauthorized possession and use of Maya's stolen physical keycard.

evidence.title: Virtual AI Ethics Seminar Attendance
evidence.description: SSO authentication and continuous webcam stream confirms Aisha was presenting live in an official online symposium during the incident.

evidence.title: Basement Utility Fiber Maintenance Slip
evidence.description: Signed maintenance log and diagnostic test runs showing Aarav was replacing fiber splice trays under supervisory badge access.

evidence.title: Server Room B Power Surge Log
evidence.description: Alert dispatch: IDS detected anomalous UDP flood. Dev Malhotra clocked into room at 20:10 to reset hardware switch.
evidence.viva_explanation: Explains the alarm triggered by Dev Malhotra as a legitimate network response.

evidence.title: Encrypted P2P Bridge Session
evidence.description: Signal log from Sam to Ryan: 'Wiped the switch port mirror on switch #03. The tunnel is dark. Meet me at 22:00 for the drive exchange.'
evidence.viva_explanation: Reveals the conspiracy between Ryan and accomplice Sam Verma.

evidence.title: Security Guard Patrol Roster & GPS
evidence.description: Radio GPS beacon log confirms Karan Joshi walked the outer perimeter fence throughout the critical timeframe.
evidence.viva_explanation: Validates guard Karan Joshi's patrol route.

evidence.title: Guest House Dining Hall Receipt
evidence.description: Table bill for 6 visiting professors including Ishaan Rao, signed by department chair.
evidence.viva_explanation: Verifies Ishaan Rao's presence at the faculty dinner.

evidence.title: University Library IP Jump Tunnel Trace
evidence.description: Network Packet Capture: Library workstation IP 192.168.40.88 opened an automated reverse SSH tunnel to Apex Lab workstation 04, spoofing active usage while Ryan physically walked to the lab.
evidence.viva_explanation: Smoking gun technical evidence shattering Ryan's library alibi.

evidence.title: Anonymous Tip via Campus Hotline
evidence.description: Caller stated they saw someone in a navy blue jacket rushing through the breezeway between the Lab and Library around 19:50.
evidence.viva_explanation: Corroborating witness tip supporting the CCTV footage.

evidence.title: Swiss Crypto Escrow Contract #XMR-992
evidence.description: Escrow transaction registered on public mempool with memo: 'CHIMERA_STAGE1_AUTH'. Target wallet linked to Ryan's registered exchange account.
evidence.viva_explanation: Irrefutable financial proof sealing the prosecution case.
